title: Tiered Tulle Sweetheart Sheer-Waist Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Tiered Tulle Sheer-Waist Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Maternity photoshoot gown in sky blue tulle with a sweetheart bodice, sheer waist, puff sleeves, high slit and tiers. US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a sky blue tulle gown with a pleated sweetheart bodice, soft puff sleeves worn off the shoulders, a sheer waist that frames the bump, and a skirt of big airy tiers that parts in a high slit and sweeps into a train.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 7 days, so please allow about 19-23 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
pleated sweetheart bodice, gathered tulle puff sleeves worn off the shoulders, a sheer tulle waist, and a full tiered tulle skirt with a high front slit and a sweeping train.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the sheer waist and full tiered skirt leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a sky blue tulle maternity gown with a pleated sweetheart bodice with underwire-style cups, gathered tulle puff sleeves worn off the shoulders, a sheer tulle waist section that shows the bump, and a very full floor-length skirt of wide, airy, gathered tulle tiers with a high front slit and a sweeping train

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Tiered Tulle Sweetheart Sheer-Waist Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in SKY BLUE (a soft sky blue).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): a sky blue tulle maternity gown with a pleated sweetheart bodice with underwire-style cups, gathered tulle puff sleeves worn off the shoulders, a sheer tulle waist section that shows the bump, and a very full floor-length skirt of wide, airy, gathered tulle tiers with a high front slit and a sweeping train. The tiers are wide, soft and gathered, with a sheer waist section between the bodice and the first tier.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light backdrop, wearing this gown, one hand on her bump, the other holding the skirt out so the tiers and the slit show; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a flower meadow at golden hour, the tulle tiers and sleeves moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a white dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, skirt spread around the base, showing the pleated sweetheart bodice, puff sleeves, sheer waist and wide tulle tiers clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: sky blue colour, pleated sweetheart bodice, puff sleeves worn off the shoulders, sheer tulle waist, very full floor-length skirt of wide tulle tiers with a high front slit and a train. No belt, no sequins. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, the sheer waist, tiers or slit are missing, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
